displayIdentity.body: Jesus casts out a mute demon, and the man speaks. Some marvel, while others test Jesus or accuse him of working through Beelzebul. Jesus answers with Satan’s divided kingdom, God’s finger, the strong man, and gathering.
displayIdentity.title: A mute man speaks and Jesus contrasts Satan with God’s finger
